Looking at the images:

**Page 8**: Contains §5.2, §5.3, §5.4 (End-to-End Learning), §6 Discussion, and starts §7 Conclusion. The Conclusion heading and its main text appear at the very bottom right.

**Page 9**: Starts with "strategy-conditioned classifiers; code and data will be released upon acceptance." at the very top left. Then Limitations, and References start.

So the Conclusion STILL spills onto page 9 by about 1 line. I need to save 1 more line somewhere on page 8.


Let me try trimming the end-to-end section or the temperature section further, or maybe reduce vertical spacing. Looking more carefully at §5.4, I see it still has 4 sentences. I could shorten the last sentence to free up space.

Now I'm looking at the full section—the linear probing results show that PLMs can't recover the dominant depth features despite SHAP attributing most of RF's performance to perplexity and surprisal metrics. DCOL only reaches 64.5%, and all end-to-end approaches substantially underperform feature-based methods, which suggests that explicit distributional statistics are crucial for depth estimation.
